name: Pursue, explore, redirect, or stop
acceptance_condition: An authorized value, feasibility, economic, and risk decision is recorded.
decision: Pursue with bounded ERP-connectivity experiment and pilot budget ceiling.

name: Process and organization ready
acceptance_condition: The tailored way of working, ownership, controls, and first increment are authorized.
decision: Authorized standard profile, named owners, first vertical slice, evidence rules, and operations policy.

name: CIM accepted for the slice
acceptance_condition: Meaning, requirements, behavior, acceptance, trace, and explicit semantic-validation evidence are adequate.
decision: Accepted CIM revision for shipment telemetry and excursion response.

name: PIM accepted and platform-mappable
acceptance_condition: Contracts, failure behavior, security, data, SLOs, trace, and provider capability needs are explicit.
decision: Accepted PIM after adding idempotency and late-event policies.

name: PSM accepted for generation
acceptance_condition: The exact PSM revision, trace, manual decisions, and explicit semantic-validation evidence are accepted.
decision: Accepted AWS PSM with manual private-ERP mapping explicitly owned.

name: Increment accepted, reworked, or deferred
acceptance_condition: Value, verification, security, operability, trace, and explicit exceptions are accepted for the exact increment.
decision: Increment 1 accepted; Increment 2 initially reworked, then accepted after retry-policy correction.

name: Release authorized, rejected, or exception accepted
acceptance_condition: The exact immutable candidate and recovery, assurance, operational, and economic evidence are accepted.
decision: Release 1 authorized; Release 2 rejected once at stop threshold, corrected, then authorized.

name: Release transitioned to Operations and Maintenance
acceptance_condition: The running release, support obligations, observability, recovery, and ownership are accepted.
decision: Each promoted release was handed to Operations with SLO, runbook, rollback, cost, and support evidence.

name: Shared lifecycle closure accepted
acceptance_condition: No live release, unowned data/records obligation, active access path, residual chargeable resource, or unresolved closure blocker remains.
decision: Shared closure accepted after zero live releases and closure of access, cost, records, and data obligations.
